sources.applied: Explicit version command, required --message, keep-tabular and skip directories; never delete old versions
Documented unversioned owner/slug dataset_sources; no invented attachment version pin

conclusions: Version request includes notes, files and delete_old_versions=False; no visibility or predecessor field
Predecessor is an operator assertion/local duplicate key, not server compare-and-swap
Client has its own retry wrapper; publisher does not reinvoke uncertain commands automatically
Dataset files/download API accepts explicit numeric dataset version
Notebook payload/archive/manifest checks bind actual bytes before source import despite unversioned attachment
